title: CastillosCVEP40
description: This dataset contains 32-channel EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class reactive BCI task with code-modulated visual evoked potentials (c-VEP). It compares burst and m-sequence stimulation patterns at 100% and 40% amplitude depth, and this BIDS version contains the 40% amplitude m-sequence condition. The data support evaluation of CNN-based decoding with minimal calibration data and of user visual comfort.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainProducts LiveAmp (32 active electrodes, 500 Hz, impedance below 25 kOhm). Participants attended to four cued disc targets flickering on a 60 Hz monitor. Each trial had a 0.5 s cue, 2.2 s of stimulation and a 0.7 s inter-trial interval, with 15 blocks of 4 trials per condition. Preprocessing comprised average re-referencing, a 49.9-50.1 Hz IIR notch filter, epoching and baseline removal. Classification used a CNN with sliding windows for bitwise decoding.
